plugins.name: stratos-memory-stack
plugins.description: Memory that learns and keeps itself current. Seven-layer memory stack (claude-mem, basic-memory, Obsidian, Pinecone, CLAUDE.md/MEMORY.md, STATE.md, plus an optional unified retrieval engine: one pgvector table, hybrid search, RRF fusion, MCP primitives) with a nightly learning loop: capture hook, recurrence-gated consolidation, cross-department scouts, and a conductor that ranks findings into a daily board. Optional Mode Activators hook for multi-stream vaults. Auto-audits and guides install.
